selection.reason: The lamp combines rear position, stop and reversing functions (and possibly a direction indicator), all of which are light-signalling devices within R148, which consolidates R6, R7, R23 and R38.
The integrated retro-reflector prism plate is a retro-reflective device covered by R150, which consolidates R3 and R104.
R48 governs the mounting position, geometric visibility, number and electrical connection of rear position, stop and reversing lamps and rear retro-reflectors on N3 trucks and O trailers.
The LED PCB with SMD LEDs, a multi-pin connector and further electronic components is an electrical/electronic sub-assembly, so it must meet EMC emission and immunity requirements.
Position and stop lamp requirements are consolidated into R148, which is selected instead.
Reversing lamp requirements are consolidated into R148, which is selected instead.
Retro-reflector requirements are consolidated into R150, which is selected instead.
The LEDs are SMD LEDs soldered on a PCB, not replaceable standardised LED light source categories.
The lamp has a small retro-reflector rather than retro-reflective marking tape, and R104 is consolidated into R150 anyway.

drawing.product: Multi-function rear combination lamp (tail/stop/reversing lamp with integrated retro-reflector), shown as an exploded isometric view
drawing.vehicle_location: Rear of vehicle (exterior, rear body or rear frame/bumper area); the callouts name rear position, stop and reversing functions, which are rear-facing signals

parts.name: Outer lens
parts.function: Closes the lamp to the front, transmits and colours the emitted light and protects the internal parts
parts.technology: Transparent moulded plastic lens, labelled red; a separate rectangular window area is visible, probably a clear zone for the reversing function
parts.evidence: Front-most rounded-rectangular part with hatch lines indicating transparency and a raised rectangular inset in the upper right; callout 'Outer lens – red'

parts.name: Retro-reflector
parts.function: Returns incident light from other vehicles' headlamps (passive conspicuity)
parts.technology: Retro-reflective prism plate, small rectangular insert
parts.evidence: Small rectangular element with vertical line pattern between the lens and the gasket; callout 'Retro-reflector'

parts.name: Seal / gasket
parts.function: Seals the lens-to-housing joint against water and dust ingress
parts.technology: Elastomer perimeter gasket (rubber or foam), thin ring following the lamp outline
parts.evidence: Thin double-line outline frame of the same shape as the lens with an open centre; callout 'Seal / gasket – no water ingress'

parts.name: Reflector / optic carrier
parts.function: Shapes and directs the light of the position lamp and the other light sources; contains separate optical chambers
parts.technology: Moulded plastic reflector, probably metallised, with an array of round optical cells, a vertical rectangular compartment and a gridded rectangular section
parts.evidence: Third layer with rows of oval cells, small square cells along the top, a tall rectangular slot and a hatched rectangular area at upper right; callout 'Reflector – rear position lamp'

parts.name: LED modules on PCB
parts.function: Light sources for the lamp functions (stop lamp named in callout) plus the electrical interface
parts.technology: Electronic printed circuit board with an array of SMD LEDs; a multi-pin connector and one larger square component (possibly a larger LED or sensor area) are on the board
parts.evidence: Flat rectangular board with rows of small square elements containing circular marks, a striped connector-like block and a square element with a circle; callout 'LED modules on PCB – stop lamp'

parts.name: Housing
parts.function: Rear body that carries the optics and PCB, gives the mounting points and closes the lamp at the back
parts.technology: Moulded plastic housing (opaque), deep tray shape with screw bosses/holes in the corners
parts.evidence: Rear-most deep tray with oval holes near the corners and visible side walls/depth; callout 'Housing'

parts.name: Fasteners / clips
parts.function: Fix the lamp assembly to the vehicle and hold it in its aimed position
parts.evidence: Three rod-shaped fasteners with oval heads aligned with the housing holes along dash-dot assembly lines; callout 'Fasteners / clips'
